mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the past 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.8% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger a flight to safety, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months where UNRATE exceeds 4.8%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in both housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 110) and rising unemployment (UNRATE > 4.5%), the economy is in a supply-driven slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO < 110 and UNRATE > 4.5%, or the Rank IC for the joint condition is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) over the past 3 months signals strong consumer spending, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where RSAFS has increased over the past 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) rises above 2.5% year-over-year, it signals accelerating inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months where CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 2.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in both employment (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate a labor market contraction, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle economic expansions characterized by high housing starts (HOUST > 1500) and strong retail sales (RSAFS > 370000), the market anticipates a slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST > 1500 and RSAFS > 370000, or the Rank IC for the joint condition is below 0.03.
